Write pulse bit field:#br#FSM Reset Trigger #br#Initiates function like STC_RESET. #br#Refer to https://confluence.itg.ti.com/display/LPR/LPR+Reset

Reset cause register for FEC CPU#br#0x00 - All cleared#br#0x01 - Power On Reset (PoR)#br#0x02 - Subsystem Reset (Combination of Warm Reset initiated from PRCM using LPRADAR:TOP_PRCM:RST_FEC_PD_SOFT_RESET and PoR reset)#br#0x04 - STC RESET#br#0x08 - Software controlled Power On Reset (PoR) Pulse#br#0x10 - CPU Only Reset triggered by writing to LPRADAR:FEC_RCM:RST_FSM_TRIG<RST_FSM_TRIG_CM3> (self triggered CPU reset during MEMSWAP/ECLIPSE mode to wait for WFI to assert the reset to CPU).#br#0x20 - Core Reset initiated from PRCM using LPRADAR:TOP_PRCM:RST_SOFT_FEC_CORE_SYSRESET_REQ (reset CPU unconditionally - by debugger) or LPRADAR:TOP_PRCM:FEC_CORE_SYSRESET_PARAM_WAKEUP_OUT_STATE#br#0x40 - Reserved
